title: Connected Nations FAQs
findings: Ofcom states that the Connected Nations Methodology Annex explains the criteria used to generate its output files.
Ofcom states that fixed broadband and mobile are provided as separate data downloads and that the file title identifies whether a download relates to fixed or mobile.
Ofcom states that fixed broadband coverage downloads provide maximum available speed details and accompany every Connected Nations publication.
relevance_to_first_missing_criterion: Official metadata helps identify and validate that the missing target is the fixed-broadband coverage download family and that output-generation criteria are defined by the Methodology Annex. It does not provide the Spring 2026 corrected-r2 archive bytes, CRC, or 121 postcode members.
